title: Extend react_ui/src/api/client.ts with voice API functions and create useAudioRecorder hook
description:
Extend react_ui/src/api/client.ts with typed TypeScript API functions for the voice endpoints and create react_ui/src/hooks/useAudioRecorder.ts — a custom React hook wrapping the browser MediaRecorder API.

--- client.ts audio extension ---

Add TypeScript types:
- `VoicePreferences`: ttsProviderId (string | null), ttsModelId (string | null), sttProviderId (string | null), sttModelId (string | null), voiceSpeed (number | null), voicePitch (number | null), voiceEnabled (boolean).
- `SynthesizeRequest`: text (string), mood (string | undefined), mode (string | undefined).
- `SynthesizeResponse`: audioUrl (string), durationMs (number), format (string).
- `TranscribeRequest`: audioBase64 (string), format (string), language (string | undefined).
- `TranscribeResponse`: text (string), confidence (number), languageDetected (string | null).

Add API functions using the existing fetchApi wrapper pattern from client.ts:
- `fetchVoicePreferences()`: GET /api/voice/preferences
- `updateVoicePreferences(prefs: Partial<VoicePreferences>)`: PUT /api/voice/preferences
- `synthesizeSpeech(req: SynthesizeRequest)`: POST /api/voice/synthesize
- `transcribeAudio(req: TranscribeRequest)`: POST /api/voice/transcribe

--- useAudioRecorder.ts hook ---

Create react_ui/src/hooks/useAudioRecorder.ts exporting a `useAudioRecorder` hook that:
- Returns: { isRecording, startRecording, stopRecording, audioBlob, audioBase64, error, isSupported }
- `isSupported`: boolean indicating if MediaRecorder API is available in this browser.
- `startRecording()`: requests microphone permission via navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }), creates a MediaRecorder instance, starts recording with MIME type 'audio/webm' fallback. Stores chunks and updates states.
- `stopRecording()`: stops the MediaRecorder, compiles chunks into a Blob, reads as base64 via FileReader, resolves the promise with { blob, base64 }.
- Cleans up media stream tracks on unmount (useEffect cleanup).
- Handles permission denied and unsupported browser errors gracefully (sets error state).

Follow existing React hook patterns in the project (e.g., react_dashboard/frontend/src/hooks/ for conventions).

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- react_ui/src/api/client.ts for the existing fetchApi pattern, type conventions, and base URL setup
- react_dashboard/frontend/src/hooks/ for hook conventions (if any hooks exist)
- react_ui/src/ for existing project structure

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.
